lines.text: Yung jad khong rok tem barn? Reu gep khong nai ko-dung tee mai dai mart-tra-tarn?
Khor nae num... Ko-dung Premium Storage Solution mart-tra-tarn song-ork.
Pack dee, song wai, moon jai dai took chin. Son jai sung-sue tiad-tor rao dai loey krub.
